category: storage VPS / managed file storage (not object storage)

free_tier.stated: 1 TB (BX11) / 5 TB (BX21) / 10 TB (BX31) / 20 TB (BX41); 100 sub-accounts; 10/20/30/40 snapshots for BX11/BX21/BX31/BX41
free_tier.notes: Be flexible with your Storage Box. You can scale it up or down to fit your current needs, and without losing data or having to migrate it manually.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-file cap published, 100 sub-accounts, 10 snapshots 10 concurrent connections (hard, prod

retention.stated: After a resource is deleted on Hetzner Console, it cannot be recovered or restored; Storage Boxes are cancelled by deleting them there.
retention.notes: Manual snapshots are kept until the user deletes them; automatic snapshots are deleted oldest-first once the slot limit is reached.

egress.terms: Each Storage Box comes with unlimited traffic.

interface_detail: SFTP, FTP/FTPS, SCP, rsync-over-SSH, WebDAV, Samba/CIFS, HTTPS; BorgBackup and Restic native
tooling: rclone (explicitly listed), restic, borg, rsync; no S3 API
chaining: Up to 100 sub-accounts per Storage Box, each limited to its own sub-directory; all sub-accounts use the storage space of the one Storage Box, so they do not add capacity.

limits.value: no per-file cap published, 100 sub-accounts, 10 snapshots 10 concurrent connections (hard, prod

limits_note: Up to 10 simultaneous connections per Storage Box account; snapshot slots are 10/20/30/40 for BX11/BX21/BX31/BX41; files sit on RAID disks of a single host server and the data is not mirrored onto other servers.
reliability_note: LowEndTalk regularly reports throughput is node-dependent (sub-30 Mbit/s on bad nodes) and that Hetzner's automatic usage-anomaly detection has disconnected boxes triggered by third-party traffic; 10-connection cap is the real binding constraint for parallel ranged GETs.
